content.text: This report is deeply concerning. “The Bachelorette” premiere is less than a week away, and multiple outlets are reporting that SLOMW S5 production has been halted due to conflict between Taylor Frankie Paul and Dakota Mortensen. There are not many details available at this point, but we will be following this developing story.#secretlivesofmormonwives #SLOMW #TheBacheloretteCan we please stop giving this woman a platform? After the first DV incident, we continued to watch her on reality TV. Now she’s the Bachelorette and frankly it’s disappointingThis tells us she doesn't end up with anyone from the BacheloretteIt’s not fair to the rest of the cast she’s very unstable emotionally and mentally.ugh i hope the kids are ok ♥️I didn’t understand why they chose her as bacheloretteShe was already involved in a similar incident early on in the show’s filming so it is honestly not a surprise. We would expect them to avoid choosing a male lead with a domestic violence history, so I have no idea why they thought it was ok to choose a female lead with that history. If they want someone from the show, there are others who are single.Pains me to say it but I would support not recapping if abc still chooses to air. Child abuse charges are no joke and I don’t want to support ratings/platforming directly or indirectlyThis is why I stopped watching Mormon wives and will not be watching her season of Bachelorette. It's not okay.Bachelor casting is ridiculous that they even picked her. Was not planning to watch this season anyway but now confirmed. Boycott.What is the point in watching the bachelor if I know she is still messing around with Dakota in the end? She screams at everyone who attempts to call her out for her toxic actions, saying "its a toxic cycle, we don't understand, she just wants to be heard (aka be verbally abusive until she tires herself out)."Ignoring bad behavior and giant red flags is what got us in this global mess. I love the Bachelor, but I can’t possibly support this season. She should have never been cast.@claireandemmapod could this affect whether you cover the season? If confirmed that she’s again accused of DV, I don’t know we could responsibly and in good conscience watch the season or cover it.I hope yall don’t even waste time covering this season tbhWould be wild if her season gets canceled right before it begins airing. I hope their children are alright.
